title: CLI Arguments Schema
description: JSON Schema representation of command-line arguments for PCI DSS Page Tampering Detection system

mode.description: Execution mode: 'inventory' updates baseline, 'detection' monitors production, 'all' executes both sequentially

target.description: Specific target name to process (e.g., '1.0'). If omitted, all targets in repository are processed.

repo.description: Inventory repository URL. Supports HTTPS (requires git-token) and file:// protocols for local testing.

gitToken.description: Git authentication token. Required for HTTPS repositories. Use GitHub Personal Access Token or similar.

slackToken.description: Slack OAuth token for sending alerts. If omitted, alerts are logged to console instead.

inventoryBranch.description: Git branch for inventory operations. Inventory workflow pulls from and pushes to this branch.

detectionBranch.description: Git branch for detection operations. Detection workflow pulls baseline from this branch (read-only).

help.description: Display help documentation and exit. When true, all other parameters are ignored.

examples.$comment: Full workflow (inventory + detection) for all targets
